title: Oppo gives us our best look yet at the upcoming K14 Plus, confirms memory options
description: Oppo recently announced that it would unveil the K14 Plus in India on September 29, with online retailer Flipkart revealing its design, color options, and key specs. Now, Oppo has set up a page on its Indian website and shared images of the K14 Plus, giving us our best look at it yet. The Oppo K14 Plus' white model is called Star White, and the orange version is called Solar Orange. Both have the same patterns on their back covers, along with text in the right corner that reads "Stay Cool. Stay Powered." title: Deals: massive price cuts for the Galaxy Z Fold8 and Z Flip8, Pixel 11 series also discounted
description: The Galaxy Z Fold8 and Z Flip8 are around one-third off this week – these are massive discounts for cutting-edge foldables that only launched last month. The big Z Fold8 Ultra along with the Pixel 11 series has smaller discounts that are still worth a look. The Samsung Galaxy Z Fold8 is down to €1,430 for the base 12/256GB unit. The upgrade to 512GB storage is quite pricey at the moment despite a fairly decent discount on it. As a reminder, the 256GB iPhone Duo will start at €2,300 and Apple devices aren’t as fast with the price cuts. We haven’t tested the Duo yet, but here’s an overview...

title: Honor keeps teasing the Magic9 Pro Max's cinematic mic and teleconverter
description: Honor is unveiling the Magic9 series on September 28, and since we're just a few days away from the event, the company keeps on teasing the upcoming phones. The Magic9 devices, or at least the Magic9 Pro Max, will feature a cinematic mic, and Honor's "imaging innovator" Han Han has shared how it delivers a dynamic sound experience in his daily life. This cinematic mic captures sounds from both near and far - and every sound is crystal clear, be it of fried food or a coffee machine or some clothes flapping in the distance. title: Here's proof the vivo X500 Pro Max is a cameraphone to be reckoned with
description: We had the distinct pleasure of attending vivo's X500 series unveiling in Shanghai, China. If you've never been to such an event, it's pretty nice; the maker usually arranges a bunch of photo opportunities around the location, and vivo did just that. So we went to a couple of places, vivo X500 Pro Max in hand, and took some photos. We did share a bunch of these pics with you in our hands-on, but we had more, so we're sharing them as well. This isn't a detailed review of the cameras of the X500 Pro Max, but more of a chance for you guys to check out the quality. On the back of the...

title: Motorola Edge 60 Fusion starts receiving the Android 17 update
description: Motorola has started rolling out the update to Android 17 for the Edge 60 Fusion in India, according to reports on Reddit. The update arrives over-the-air as version A171VCH.41-9, and it's a 5.2GB download, so make sure you grab it over a fast enough network. [#InlinePriceWidget,13752,1#] It's unclear whether this update brings with it Motorola's new Qira AI assistant, but it might. Anyway, everything else that comes with Android 17 is included of course. Samsung sued over Galaxy S23 Ultra, Galaxy Watch Ultra patent infringement
description: A US-based company called Ioengine is suing Samsung in the US District Court for the Eastern District of Texas, alleging that the Korean company is using five of its connectivity-related patents without authorization or compensation. These patents were allegedly used by Samsung in the Galaxy S23 Ultra, Galaxy Watch Ultra, Galaxy Buds2 Pro, and Samsung's Portable SSD T7. These devices are being used as examples, by the way - they do not represent the full scope of the complaint. title: Qualcomm may be adding DirectX 12 support on its flagship Snapdragon chips
description: Qualcomm is apparently considering an official solution to better support PC game emulation on Android. According to one Chinese YouTuber, the company may be adding proper support for DirectX 12 for its Snapdragon chips. If this happens, it would make emulating PC games on Android much easier. The YouTuber in question tested the capability on a Snapdragon 8 Elite Gen 6 reference device and managed to successfully run Cyberpunk 2077 and Black Myth: Wukong through a translation layer in DirectX 12 mode. It's unclear whether Qualcomm will bring this feature to other SoCs aside from its...

title: Multiple users report lockscreen issues after installing the September Pixel Drop
description: The September Pixel Drop brought improvements to the VIP contacts widget, shored up scam detection and added the Pause Point feature to older models. And it seems that it also introduced a nasty bug to the lockscreen. One Reddit user reports that they couldn’t get through the pattern lock on their lockscreen Pixel 10 Pro XL – they couldn’t even connect the second dot of the pattern before the screen would reset. Another 10 Pro XL user in the same thread experienced similar issues but managed to find a workaround – hard restarting the phone by holding the Power and Volume Down buttons. The...

title: Insta360 may be working on a unique pair of AI-powered smart glasses
description: According to a new report from China, Insta360 is now working on a pair of AI-powered smart glasses. This apparently comes from sources close to the company. No actual details about the glasses have been revealed thus far, but Insta360 does hold a patent for "wearable glasses", which could potentially give us some hints. In that patent, Insta360 describes a pair of smart glasses that don't have a built-in battery. Instead, the battery is separate and intended to be worn on another part of the body. title: Infinix unveils GT NX Controller and GT NX Station dock
description: Infinix has now launched the GT NX Controller and the GT NX Station. The former is designed to be able to replicate "the nuanced precision" of touchscreen operation, featuring "the world's first Pixel-Level FPS Precision Touchpad" in a mobile gaming controller, delivering "mouse-like accuracy for mobile FPS titles". The GT NX Controller has an "esports-grade" three-chip low-latency architecture with "millisecond-level" Direct Connect. There are two chips in the left handle and one in the right, which ensure that "every input stays responsive and consistent". The controller has 22...

title: vivo S2 FE's launch date and design revealed by online retailer
description: A recent rumor claimed that vivo would launch the S2 FE on October 6 alongside the V80. While vivo is yet to say anything about the S2 FE, Indian online retailer Flipkart has set up a promo page on its website, confirming the smartphone's October 6 unveiling. Flipkart has also shared an image on the page, revealing the vivo S2 FE's design. The smartphone features a green-colored back panel with a camera island housing two cameras. title: Exclusive: Here's the launch timeframe of the Oppo F35 and F35 Pro
description: Oppo teased the F35 series earlier this month, and we later heard the brand would launch the F35 and F35 Pro in India in October. Now, we have a more definite launch timeframe for both models. A reliable source told us the Oppo F35 and F35 Pro will launch in India between October 5 and October 7. However, pricing remains unconfirmed. title: iQOO reveals Pad Ultra display specs and iQOO 16 camera details
description: The iQOO Pad Ultra is set to debut alongside the iQOO 16 in China next week, and ahead of the big unveiling, we got some additional specs for the tablet. The device will bring an 8.8-inch OLED display with a 165Hz refresh rate and 4,500 nits peak brightness. We also get confirmation of 2.65mm thin bezels on all four sides of the display, as well as sub-1ms response times. iQOO Pad Ultra display specs (machine translated from Chinese) The iQOO Pad Ultra will also feature a 30mm active cooling fan on the inside, which will be paired with a 12,118mm dual-layer VC heatsink for optimal...

title: Redmi 17C 5G India launch set for next week
description: Xiaomi unveiled the Redmi 17C 5G in Singapore last month and has now confirmed that the smartphone is coming to India. The company has also revealed the key specifications and color options for the Indian variant. The Redmi 17C 5G will launch in India on October 1. Based on the official listing, the Indian variant appears to be identical to the model launched in Singapore. It is confirmed to come with a 6,000mAh battery with 33W fast charging support and a 6.9-inch LCD display with a 120Hz adaptive refresh rate. title: vivo Y600i silently unveiled with an 8,000mAh battery
description: vivo has silently added a new model to its Y600 lineup in China. The new variant is called the vivo Y600i and it arrives with an 8,000mAh battery and a large 6.87-inch display. It joins the recently announced vivo Y600 Turbo and the Y600 Pro. The Y600i is powered by the Snapdragon 4 Gen 2 chipset, which is paired with 6GB of LPDDR4X RAM and 256GB of UFS 2.2 storage. It offers a microSD card slot for storage expansion. title: WeChat launches a new payment app for tourists in China
description: China doesn't run on cards or cash - it runs on app-based payments. WeChat Pay and Alipay rule, and while you could use both as a tourist before, WeChat is launching a new dedicated payment app for tourists. It's called TenPayGo and you can pay with it wherever WeChat Pay is accepted. You download it, set it up with your email address, and you can choose to use Apple Pay, another payment wallet ("nearly 60" international ones are supported), or your card directly through it. title: HMD Aura 2 Pro specs and renders leak
description: HMD launched the Aura in 2024 and the Aura 2 in 2025, and now it's apparently time for the Aura 2 Pro. Almost. According to a new leak from a reliable source of HMD-related information, the Aura 2 Pro is on its way. It will allegedly have a 6.75-inch LCD screen with a 90Hz refresh rate, a 50MP main camera, a couple of decorative sensors on the back - a 0.08MP one and a 2MP one too, for good measure - and a 5MP selfie snapper on the front. title: Here's how much Honor's Magic9 will cost
description: Honor is making the Magic9 series official on September 28, but ahead of that today the company's CEO, Li Jian, has revealed the pricing for the vanilla Magic9 - or rather, one version of it, the one with 16GB of RAM and 512GB of storage. This will have a normal price of CNY 6,499 ($968), but there will be a special price of CNY 5,999 ($893) in celebration of the Magic series' tenth anniversary. There's also a Chinese national subsidy that can take it down to CNY 5,499 ($819). For comparison, note that the recently launched vivo X500 goes for CNY 5,999 ($893) with 12GB of RAM and 512GB...

title: HMD Vibe2 Pro is launching next week with a 6,000mAh battery
description: HMD launched the Vibe2 in India in May, and the company has now confirmed that the lineup is expanding with a new Pro variant. HMD has also revealed several key specifications and the launch date for the upcoming Vibe2 Pro. The HMD Vibe2 Pro will launch in India on September 29. It will be powered by the MediaTek Dimensity 6400 chipset, which will be paired with up to 8GB of RAM and 128GB of storage.
